description: High humidity combined with warm temperatures creates ideal conditions for fungal diseases like blight, mildew, and rust to spread rapidly in the field.
recommended_action: Apply preventive fungicide spray (mancozeb or copper oxychloride at 2.5 g/litre). Improve field drainage, avoid overhead irrigation, and inspect crops daily.

description: High humidity with warm night temperatures (above 24°C) and heavy rainfall creates ideal blast infection conditions. Night dew on leaves prolongs spore infection period.
recommended_action: Spray tricyclazole at 0.6 g/litre immediately. Drain excess water from fields. Monitor neck emergence stage carefully — blast at this stage causes maximum yield loss.

description: Extreme heat with very low humidity and no rainfall causes severe water stress. Plants will wilt rapidly with significant crop loss potential if irrigation is not provided within 24–48 hours.
recommended_action: Start emergency irrigation immediately. Apply mulch to retain soil moisture. Spray anti-transpirants on foliage. Prioritize high-value crops first. Consider contingency crop planning.

description: Very low temperatures with high humidity at night cause frost formation on plant surfaces, damaging tender crops, flower buds, and recently transplanted seedlings.
recommended_action: Cover tender crops with straw/polythene sheets at night. Apply light irrigation in the evening to maintain soil warmth. Harvest any mature fruits or vegetables immediately.

description: Warm, dry conditions with minimal rainfall favour rapid multiplication of sucking pests like whitefly, aphids, and thrips. These pests also spread mosaic virus.
recommended_action: Install yellow sticky traps (10/acre). Spray imidacloprid 0.3 ml/litre or neem oil 5 ml/litre. Yellow leaf colour change is early warning sign — check undersides of leaves daily.

description: Hot and dry conditions with light rains create favourable conditions for locust breeding and swarming in desert-bordering areas. Swarms can destroy entire fields within hours.
recommended_action: Report locust sightings to district agricultural officer immediately. Participate in coordinated spraying drives. Protect crop boundaries with netting if possible. Monitor cloud formation at dawn.

description: Cool, wet conditions are ideal for Late Blight (Phytophthora infestans). This disease can spread across an entire field in 3–5 days in these conditions and cause 100% crop loss.
recommended_action: Apply metalaxyl + mancozeb combination spray immediately. Inspect entire field for water-soaked black lesions. Remove infected plants — do not compost. Improve field drainage urgently.

description: High temperatures during flowering and grain filling stage cause forced maturity, shrivelled grains, and up to 30% yield reduction in Rabi crops.
recommended_action: Apply protective irrigation immediately (if available). Spray potassium chloride (0.5%) + salicylic acid (0.1%) mixture as heat stress mitigator. Harvest as soon as crops approach maturity.

description: Heavy rainfall causes waterlogging in clay-heavy soils, depriving crop roots of oxygen. Plants show wilting within 24–48 hours despite saturated soil.
recommended_action: Open drainage channels urgently — create bunds to divert water. Do not fertilize waterlogged field. Spray nutrient solution on foliage. Assess re-sowing if 50%+ stand is damaged.

description: Warm and humid conditions after the monsoon onset trigger mass emergence of stem borer moths (Scirpophaga) for egg-laying. Dead heart symptoms appear 15–20 days later.
recommended_action: Apply carbofuran 3G granules at 10 kg/acre in field water. Set up pheromone traps (5/acre). Use light traps at night. Chlorpyrifos 2 ml/litre spray around crop base.

description: Current weather conditions are mild and suitable for crop growth. Moderate temperature with comfortable humidity supports photosynthesis and nutrient uptake.
recommended_action: No immediate weather-related risk. Continue regular crop monitoring. This is an ideal time to apply scheduled fertilizers and maintain irrigation schedule.

risk_name: Storm Lodging Risk for Tall Crops
description: Heavy rainfall combined with strong winds can cause lodging (stem bending/breaking) in tall cereal crops at grain-filling stage, making harvest difficult and reducing quality.
recommended_action: Apply silicon-based fertilizer to strengthen cell walls before storm season. Consider windbreak plantings on field perimeter. Harvest mature crop promptly. Brush lodged plants upright if mild lodging occurs.
